purpose: Catalog of songs with direct YouTube video links for an embedded YouTube player on the website. A video URL does not guarantee embedding/playback availability.

data_quality.note: Duplicate song titles within the same artist were removed, keeping the first occurrence. Song IDs are assigned sequentially per artist.

image_url_update.method: YouTube thumbnail URLs derived from existing YouTube video IDs in the catalog
image_url_update.songs: Thumbnail URL populated when a song has a YouTube video_id.
image_url_update.albums: Uses first associated song thumbnail as a representative image when album artwork was missing; not verified official album artwork.
image_url_update.artists: Uses first associated song thumbnail as a representative image when artist portrait was missing; not a verified artist portrait.
image_url_update.note: YouTube thumbnail URLs may be unavailable for removed/private videos; review image URLs before production.
